Container.Name: account-cleanup
Container.Overview: Track your online accounts from a Bitwarden (or other password manager) export and delete the old ones a little at a time. Passwords are never stored. AI-written personal project - use at your own risk.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where the tracker database is stored

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Decides when the daily suggestion rolls over

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. If set, the web UI asks for a login (username below)

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: Login username, used only when a password is set

Config.Name: Bitwarden client_id
Config.Description: Optional. Personal API key client_id (Bitwarden: Settings - Security - Keys - View API key). Enables vault sync and delete.

Config.Name: Bitwarden server
Config.Description: Leave empty for bitwarden.com. Use https://vault.bitwarden.eu for the EU cloud, or your Vaultwarden URL

Config.Name: Vault auto-lock minutes
Config.Description: Lock the vault after this many idle minutes

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as
